binding_modes.rule: exactly one mode; duplicate ids or mixed modes fail

required: Artifact Registry index and its explicitly listed D05 fragment

member_adapters.candidate_number: exactly one list item whose number equals member_ref.value
member_adapters.catalog_69_id: exactly one obras item whose id equals member_ref.value
member_adapters.checkpoint: top-level numero and obras_examinadas exactly equal the structured member_ref.value
member_adapters.evidence_id: exactly one revisoes item whose evidence_id equals member_ref.value
member_adapters.none: the occurrence itself is the selected member
member_adapters.work_id_enrichment_queue: exactly one fila item whose work_id equals member_ref.value

output_contract.machine_absolute_paths: excluded from canonical core; optional only in separate noncanonical runtime report
output_contract.recommended_location: caller-selected temporary runtime directory, outside D05 and outside authoritative Registry/Lock trees

checks: relative_path is canonical NFC POSIX syntax
relative_path is not absolute, drive-relative, UNC, device-path or ADS syntax
no empty, dot or dot-dot components
root binding is explicit, absolute, existing and unique
resolved target remains within the resolved root
no selected path traverses a symlink, junction or reparse point
no NFC-plus-casefold collision inside a storage root
Windows reserved names and trailing dot/space aliases are rejected
basename never substitutes for occurrence identity

resolution_algorithm: parse only explicitly supplied files and bindings
compare actual Lock SHA-256 to the explicit expected digest
compare Registry index SHA-256 to the digest pinned by the Lock
open only fragment paths explicitly listed by the Registry index and validate descriptor size/hash
compare Lock fragment pins to the validated Registry fragments
build in-memory uniqueness indexes without filesystem enumeration
validate Lock constraints, counts, digests, ordinals and no-implicit-selection rules without Golden
resolve each Lock item by logical_id plus version plus occurrence_id
bind storage_root_id explicitly and validate the physical path
check file existence, stable size and SHA-256 using the opened file
resolve member_ref through the fixed D05 adapter for its set and kind
append the resolved item in Lock set/item order without deduplication
copy explicit_absences without attempting file resolution
resolve all four dependencies and enforce restricted_local fail-closed
serialize the canonical shadow output deterministically

root_bindings.required_ids: exactly the storage_root_id values referenced by selected occurrences and dependencies

success_criteria_r1b: preserves order, multiplicity and explicit absences
fails closed when restricted_local is absent
changes no consumer and produces no functional D05 output
verifier_contract: validate Registry canonical structure and cryptographic links without orphan scanning
validate Lock canonical structure, explicit expected hash and Registry pins without Golden
validate complete and unique root bindings
validate exact one-to-one occurrence and member resolution
validate path confinement and Windows alias/collision rules
validate file existence, size and SHA-256
validate explicit absences are preserved as data
validate zero extra item and zero implicit discovery

allowed_filesystem_operations: read size from an explicit file handle/path
inspect explicit path components for reparse points
